job.job_description:
Job Location- Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Pune




Must have skills which are non-negotiable

GenAI
Python
Lang Chain
LangGraph
AWS Bedrock

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Generative AI Developer with strong expertise in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, LangGraph, Python, and AWS Bedrock.




The ideal candidate should have experience building scalable AI applications, agentic workflows, prompt engineering frameworks, and integrating LLM-powered solutions with enterprise platforms.




Required Skills

Hands-on experience in developing Generative AI applications using Python
Strong experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), including model selection, fine-tuning concepts, prompt engineering, and evaluation
Hands-on expertise in LangChain for AI orchestration, tool integration, memory management, and agent development
Strong experience with LangGraph for building multi-agent and stateful AI workflows
Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock and foundation model integration
Experience integrating vector databases such as OpenSearch, Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, or Weaviate
Strong knowledge of embeddings, semantic search, chunking strategies, and document processing pipelines
Experience developing REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI or similar Python frameworks
Good understanding of cloud-native architectures and deployment patterns on AWS
Experience in AI application monitoring, evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices
Familiarity with model observability and evaluation frameworks
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities



Preferred Skills

Experience with Agentic AI frameworks and multi-agent systems
Knowledge of AWS services such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch
Experience with Prompt Management and AI Governance frameworks
Exposure to knowledge graph implementations and enterprise search solutions
Familiarity with MLOps, LLMOps, and AI observability platforms
Experience working in Banking and Financial Services domain



Key Responsibilities

Design and develop enterprise-scale GenAI solutions leveraging LLMs and AWS Bedrock
Build intelligent RAG-based applications and conversational AI assistants
Develop multi-agent workflows using LangGraph and LangChain
Optimize prompts, retrieval mechanisms, and model performance for business use cases
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and knowledge repositories
Establish AI application monitoring, evaluation, and governance practices
Collaborate with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-powered capabilities
Mentor junior developers and provide technical lead ership on GenAI initiatives

Important :


Notice period : Immediate to 15-30 days ONLY.

Candidates serving Notice period will be preferred.


Please note - There should not be Career Gap more than 6 months(No Career Break)




Graduation score should be 60% & above




Pre Screening BGV (Background Verification)is mandatory [UAN/PF without any overlap issue is required.]
